---
title: FileDriver
description: "Filesystem cache driver storing each key as a serialized file with TTL-based expiry."
---

<ApiBadge type="driver" />
<ApiBadge type="cache" />
<ApiBadge type="filesystem" />
<ApiBadge type="fail-soft" />

`Skim\Cache\FileDriver` persists cache entries as individual files on disk. Each file contains a serialized tuple of [expiry_timestamp, value]. Keys are base64-encoded for safe filenames. TTL is tracked via the serialized expiry, not file mtime. The driver falls back gracefully when the directory is not writable.

```txt
Symbol: Skim\Cache\FileDriver
Source: src/Cache/FileDriver.php
Lifecycle: persistent across requests, TTL enforced on read
Fallback: default cache driver when Redis is unreachable
```

<CodeExample label="Basic usage" source="llm-generated">
```php
$driver = new FileDriver(path: sys_get_temp_dir() . '/skim_cache');
$driver->set('user:1', $userData, 3600);
```
</CodeExample>

<WarningBox>

flushAll() deletes every .cache file in the configured path

</WarningBox>

<WarningBox>

Not suitable for high-throughput production workloads — prefer Redis

</WarningBox>

## Architecture

Each key maps to one file: base64(key).cache containing serialize([$expires, $value]). The driver is the default fallback when Redis is unavailable.

<NoteBox>

TTL tracked via serialized expiry timestamp, not file mtime (mtime unreliable on some filesystems). Falls back gracefully when directory is not writable.

</NoteBox>

## Read API

<ApiMethod name="get">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
```

</ApiSignature>

Reads the cache file, unserializes the payload, checks expiry, and returns the value or $default. Deletes expired files on read.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to read.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$default" type="mixed">

Fallback returned on miss or expiry.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="has">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function has(string $key): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Delegates to get() with a sentinel default to detect misses and expiry.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to test.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

## Write API

<ApiMethod name="set">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function set(string $key, mixed $value, ?int $ttl = null): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Serializes [expiry, value] and writes atomically with LOCK_EX. Returns false when the directory is not writable.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Cache key to write.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$value" type="mixed" required>

Payload to persist.

</ApiParam>

<ApiParam name="$ttl" type="?int">

TTL in seconds, or null for no expiry.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="delete">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function delete(string $key): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Deletes the cache file for the key. Returns true if the file was absent or successfully unlinked.

<ApiParam name="$key" type="string" required>

Exact cache key to remove.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

## Invalidation

<ApiMethod name="flush">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function flush(string $prefix): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Scans the cache directory for .cache files, decodes filenames to keys, and deletes those matching the prefix.

<ApiParam name="$prefix" type="string" required>

Key prefix to match.

</ApiParam>

</ApiMethod>

<ApiMethod name="flushAll">

<ApiSignature>

```php
public function flushAll(): bool
```

</ApiSignature>

Deletes every .cache file in the configured cache directory.

<WarningBox>

Deletes every .cache file in the configured path unconditionally

</WarningBox>

</ApiMethod>
